final: WITH manager_death_country AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), country_totals AS (SELECT death_country, SUM(award_count) as country_total FROM manager_death_country GROUP BY death_country) SELECT mdc.player_id, mdc.death_country, mdc.award_count, CAST(mdc.award_count AS FLOAT) / ct.country_total as share FROM manager_death_country mdc JOIN country_totals ct ON mdc.death_country = ct.death_country ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
